Spårgraf: what CAD sends to Studio (CAD-10). Ids are never changed when the module is
redrawn, and never used again for something else (CAD-20). geometry is "mm" for a module's
real geometry; a drawing read by the photo chain for Studio gives "schema" (bildkedjan, 21).

trainmeet.cad-1.module-list.Trapezoid.description:
A trapezoid, as MMM's (685 × 480/280): the gables parallel, length apart, width_a and
width_b wide. Gable B's corner at Kant 1 lies offset mm from gable A's across the module (y
down), the förskjutning the photo test solved for (lärdomarna, Trapets). With offset 0 Kant 1
is straight and at right angles to the gables, and only the far side slants. A track at the
same distance from Kant 1 in both gables of a slanting Kant 1 has to bend: Lås mått makes it
straight, arc, straight, arc, straight (CAD-24).

same profile fit together. A position the profile leaves open is given per module.

first.description: Kant 1 → spår 1 in mm; null: given per module.
first.title: First

spacings.description: Spår n → spår n + 1 in mm, one fewer than the tracks; null: per module.
spacings.title: Spacings

read.description: The norm's exact measures are read in. False: they are read in before the launch (CAD-N), and what is open is given per module.
read.title: Read

uses.description: How many gables in the modules the person sees use it.
uses.title: Uses

trainmeet.cad-1.gable-profile.title: GableProfile

trainmeet.cad-1.gable-profile.Norm.description: A gable's norm: the organisation whose rules the gable follows (CAD9, CAD11, CAD12).
trainmeet.cad-1.gable-profile.Norm.title: Norm

trainmeet.cad-1.gable-profile.Owner.description: Who owns a module or an own gable profile: a person or a club in TrainMeet ID.
trainmeet.cad-1.gable-profile.Owner.title: Owner

trainmeet.cad-1.new-profile.description:
An own gable profile, a person's or a club's: every track's position from Kant 1. A club's
profile can be the club's own norm (CAD11).

owner.description: A club's id; null: the person's own.
owner.title: Owner

trainmeet.cad-1.new-profile.title: NewProfile

trainmeet.cad-1.new-profile.Norm.description: A gable's norm: the organisation whose rules the gable follows (CAD9, CAD11, CAD12).
trainmeet.cad-1.new-profile.Norm.title: Norm

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.description:
Spårgraf: what CAD sends to Studio (CAD-10). Ids are never changed when the module is
redrawn, and never used again for something else (CAD-20). geometry is "mm" for a module's
real geometry; a drawing read by the photo chain for Studio gives "schema" (bildkedjan, 21).
complete is false while the tracks between the gables are unknown: a module from measures
whose gables differ waits for its photo or its drawing.

issued.description: Ids issued so far; the next is one more.
issued.title: Issued

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.title: TrackGraph

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.ArcSegment.description:
ARC: a circular piece of track centre, in mm, as DXF's ARC. clockwise is as the drawing
shows it, with y down.
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.ArcSegment.title: ArcSegment

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.Certainty.description: How sure a fact is, as in the import and the photo chain (bildkedjan, principle 4).
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.Certainty.title: Certainty

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphLabel.description:
Etikett: a text in the drawing at a point in mm, on a piece or a switch or free
(bildkedjan, R4 and point 21). The Text tool writes them.

ref.description: The piece or switch it names.
ref.title: Ref

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphLabel.title: GraphLabel

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphNode.description:
Nod: where pieces meet or end. A track at a gable is a module joint with its gable and
its track number there.
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphNode.title: GraphNode

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphPiece.description: Spårbit: track centre from one node to another, as LINE and ARC segments in order.

track.description: Spårnummer, när ägaren har gett det.
track.title: Track

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphPiece.title: GraphPiece

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphSource.description: Where a piece of the graph comes from.
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphSource.title: GraphSource

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphSwitch.description:
Växel, korsningsväxel eller korsning, at a node: the station model's Switch with CAD's
ids. The diverging leg's radius and angle, when known. The node is the points (tungspetsen);
the diverging leg leaves the through track tangentially toward gable A or B (lärdomarna,
Växlar). design is the switch type from the switch library (Växeltyp), null while Okänd.

toward.description: The gable the diverging leg heads for.

locked.description: Lås växelns läge när kurvorna räknas om: Lås mått keeps the points where they are.
locked.title: Locked

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.GraphSwitch.title: GraphSwitch

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.LineSegment.description: LINE: a straight piece of track centre, in mm.
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.LineSegment.title: LineSegment

trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.NodeType.description: What is at a node. A node joins track pieces; how many depends on the type.
trainmeet.cad-1.track-graph.NodeType.title: NodeType

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.description:
Anläggning: modules together, with joints and angles (CAD-06). One scale, and gables that
fit together (CAD9). Only the shell in part a; part d builds it.
trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.title: Assembly

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.Joint.description: Skarv: two modules' gables together, at an angle (CAD-06).

a.description: The placed module's index, and its gable.
a.title: A

angle.description: The angle between them, in degrees.
angle.title: Angle

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.Joint.title: Joint

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.Owner.description: Who owns a module or an own gable profile: a person or a club in TrainMeet ID.
trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.Owner.title: Owner

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.PlacedModule.description: A module in an assembly, at the version it pinned (CAD-21), shifted and turned.

at.description: Where the module's origin (gable A at Kant 1) lies, in mm.
at.title: At

angle.description: The module's turn, in degrees, counterclockwise.
angle.title: Angle

trainmeet.cad-1.assembly.PlacedModule.title: PlacedModule

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.description:
A change set: the operations on top of version base, the newest the person read. The
view sends the whole list every time, so undo is one less and the result is always the
same for the same list. Refused with 409 when a newer version exists.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.title: DrawingEdit

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddArc.description:
Båge: an ARC from start, by radius and angle (turning right for a positive angle, as
seen along the track with y down) from the heading at start, or through three points.

heading.description: Degrees, 0 toward gable B, positive down; null: the track's.
heading.title: Heading

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddArc.title: AddArc

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddLine.description:
Rakt spår: a LINE from start to end. start_node and end_node join it to an end there;
a point on a gable becomes a module joint.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddLine.title: AddLine

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddPolyline.description: A hand-drawn line: utjämning makes it LINE and ARC at the version's level.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddPolyline.title: AddPolyline

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddSwitch.description:
Växel: the diverging leg leaves the piece's track tangentially at from_a mm from gable A,
with its radius. Either with its angle, to the left or right as seen toward the gable it
heads for, or drawn to a point: an arc of the radius and then straight to to, which also
gives the side and the gable it heads for (a track drawn from the middle of another).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AddSwitch.title: AddSwitch

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AnswerCheck.description: Answer an item in Att kolla with one of its choices.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.AnswerCheck.title: AnswerCheck

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Cut.description: Cut a piece in two at the point nearest at: the first part keeps the id.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Cut.title: Cut

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Delete.description: Delete a piece, a switch, an end or a label. The ids are never used again.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Delete.title: Delete

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Join.description: Join two ends: both move to the middle and become one node.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Join.title: Join

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.LockMeasure.description:
Lås mått (CAD-24): the track through piece, from gable A to gable B, gets its positions
a and b from Kant 1 locked, and the curve between is made straight, arc, straight, arc,
straight, fitted to the line it replaces. Null a or b: the gable's measure.

piece.description: Null: the first track from A to B.
piece.title: Piece

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.LockMeasure.title: LockMeasures

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Move.description:
Move a node, a piece, a switch or a label by a vector in mm. What hangs on it is
reshaped, never replaced.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Move.title: Move

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.MoveSwitch.description: Flytta växel: the points slide along their track; the legs follow.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.MoveSwitch.title: MoveSwitch

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetEnd.description: Make a free end a buffer stop, or a plain end again.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetEnd.title: SetEnd

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetLabel.description:
Text: a piece's track number, a switch's number, or a free label at a point. An empty
text removes it.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetLabel.title: SetLabel

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetSmoothin.description: Utjämning: the level, kept on the version; the drawn lines are made again at it.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetSmoothin.title: SetSmoothing

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetSwitch.description:
Växelinspektören: the diverging radius, the switch type ("okand" for Okänd), and Lås
växelns läge.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.SetSwitch.title: SetSwitch

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Smoothing.description: Utjämning: how a drawn or traced line becomes LINE and ARC (bildkedjan step 12).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-edit.Smoothing.title: Smoothing

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.description:
Ritningen: the working drawing after a change set, with what to check and the
inspector's facts. Nothing is saved until Spara.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.title: DrawingView

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.ArcSegment.description:
ARC: a circular piece of track centre, in mm, as DXF's ARC. clockwise is as the drawing
shows it, with y down.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.ArcSegment.title: ArcSegment

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Certainty.description: How sure a fact is, as in the import and the photo chain (bildkedjan, principle 4).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Certainty.title: Certainty

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckAnswer.description: Ägarens svar på en sak att kolla: kept with the version, by the item's key.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckAnswer.title: CheckAnswer

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckChoice.description:
An answer button. closes: the answer settles the item; action: what the view does
instead, with no answer stored (choose a switch type, open Lås mått, or answer the photo's
question in Osäkert parti).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckChoice.title: CheckChoice

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckItem.description:
Att kolla: one thing the owner answers before the track plan is approved. The key names
the kind, the parts and the measured value, so a changed value asks again.

at.description: The place in mm, in the module's coordinates.
at.title: At

assumed.description: Antagen (AR3): yellow; otherwise orange, as a proposal.
assumed.title: Assumed

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckItem.title: CheckItem

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckKind.description: Att kolla: what the code found, or (part c) what AI asks.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CheckKind.title: CheckKind

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Curve.description:
Kurvmodul: track 1's radius and the angle, from the string and sagitta or given directly.
With Kant 1 as the outer edge the curve turns right seen from gable A, as in the drawing.

width.description: The module body's width, Kant 1 to the other edge.
width.title: Width

measured.description: The string and sagitta the radius and angle came from.

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Curve.title: Curve

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CurveMeasur.description:
The owner's measurement of a curve: a string between track 1's centre at A and B, and the
sagitta (pilhöjd) from the string's middle to the track (CADMOB-03).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.CurveMeasur.title: CurveMeasure

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Deviation.description:
How far one line lies from another: the median and the largest distance, in mm, over
count points.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Deviation.title: Deviation

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingSour.description: Where the track plan comes from: the badge in Ritningen.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingSour.title: DrawingSource

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingStat.description:
What a version keeps of its drawing besides the graph: where it came from, the
utjämning, the owner's answers, the drawn lines, the locked measures, and the ids this
version split or replaced.

questions.description: The photo chain's questions (part c1): Att kolla items of the kind question, source code or ai, kept with the version.
questions.title: Questions

photo.description: The photo job the drawing came from (part c1).
photo.title: Photo

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingStat.title: DrawingState

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingStat.description:
The canvas's bottom line: Spår totalt, antal växlar, and how far the drawing lies from
its drawn lines (part c: from the photo).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawingStat.title: DrawingStats

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawnLine.description:
The line a piece was drawn from, by hand (or, in part c, traced in the photo): utjämning
makes it LINE and ARC again when its level changes, and the deviation is measured from it.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.DrawnLine.title: DrawnLine

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.EdgeSide.description: Which edge of a curve module is Kant 1.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.EdgeSide.title: EdgeSide

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Gable.description:
Gavel: a module's end, with its norm, its profile and where the tracks go through it, in
mm from Kant 1, track 1 nearest Kant 1. Without a profile it is an own gable, measured here.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Gable.title: Gable

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphLabel.description:
Etikett: a text in the drawing at a point in mm, on a piece or a switch or free
(bildkedjan, R4 and point 21). The Text tool writes them.

ref.description: The piece or switch it names.
ref.title: Ref

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphLabel.title: GraphLabel

its track number there.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphNode.title: GraphNode

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphPiece.description: Spårbit: track centre from one node to another, as LINE and ARC segments in order.

track.description: Spårnummer, när ägaren har gett det.
track.title: Track

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphPiece.title: GraphPiece

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphSource.description: Where a piece of the graph comes from.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphSource.title: GraphSource

locked.title: Locked

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.GraphSwitch.title: GraphSwitch

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.IdChange.description:
A piece split or replaced (CAD-20): Lås mått, a switch or a cut. The first new id is the
first old one, so Studio follows the owner's additions (signals, boundaries) along.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.IdChange.title: IdChange

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.LineSegment.description: LINE: a straight piece of track centre, in mm.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.LineSegment.title: LineSegment

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.LockedMeasu.description: Låst mått: a gable track's position from Kant 1, locked by the owner (CAD-24).

line.description: What the line said before, mm.
line.title: Line

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.LockedMeasu.title: LockedMeasure

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.NodeType.description: What is at a node. A node joins track pieces; how many depends on the type.
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.NodeType.title: NodeType

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Norm.description: A gable's norm: the organisation whose rules the gable follows (CAD9, CAD11, CAD12).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Norm.title: Norm

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.PhotoGrid.description:
Where a measuring image lies in the module's millimetres: pixel (0, 0)'s centre at

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.PhotoGrid.title: PhotoGrid

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.PhotoLayer.description: Fotot under: the measuring image under the drawing, in the module's millimetres.

url.description: The measuring image at 1 px per mm, a signed address.
url.title: Url

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.PhotoLayer.title: PhotoLayer

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.ScaleLimits.description:
What the code holds a drawing in a scale to (cad/switches.py says where each comes from):
the track's minimum radius and the kink check, the switches' lower limit, and the gauge.

switch_min_radius.description: Växelns nedre gräns för radien, mm.
switch_min_radius.title: Switch Min Radius

kink.description: Största vinkelhopp på 10 mm innan det är en knyck, °.
kink.title: Kink

gable_tolerance.description: Hur långt ett gavelspår får ligga från gavelns mått innan det visas, mm.
gable_tolerance.title: Gable Tolerance

design_tolerance.description: How far a switch's radius may lie from a type's, as a fraction.
design_tolerance.title: Design Tolerance

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.ScaleLimits.title: ScaleLimits

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Smoothing.description: Utjämning: how a drawn or traced line becomes LINE and ARC (bildkedjan step 12).
trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Smoothing.title: Smoothing

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SmoothingLe.description:

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SmoothingLe.title: SmoothingLevel

length.description: Along Kant 1, gable A to gable B.
length.title: Length

width.description: Gable width, Kant 1 to the far side.
width.title: Width

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SwitchDesig.description:
Växeltyp: a known switch in the switch library, with the diverging leg's radius and angle,
and where the numbers come from (bildkedjan step 12). Okänd has neither.

source.description: Where the radius and angle come from.
source.title: Source

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SwitchDesig.title: SwitchDesign

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SwitchInfo.description: Växelinspektören: one switch as the inspector shows it.

leaves.description: The track it leaves and toward which: "spår från A4 mot A3".
leaves.title: Leaves

matched.description: The type its radius matches within the tolerance.
matched.title: Matched

assumed.description: Antagen (AR3): Okänd and no type within the tolerance.
assumed.title: Assumed

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.SwitchInfo.title: SwitchInfo

trainmeet.cad-1.drawing-view.Trapezoid.description:
A trapezoid, as MMM's (685 × 480/280): the gables parallel, length apart, width_a and
width_b wide. Gable B's corner at Kant 1 lies offset mm from gable A's across the module (y
down), the förskjutning the photo test solved for (lärdomarna, Trapets). With offset 0 Kant 1
is straight and at right angles to the gables, and only the far side slants. A track at the
same distance from Kant 1 in both gables of a slanting Kant 1 has to bend: Lås mått makes it
straight, arc, straight, arc, straight (CAD-24).

offset.description: Förskjutning: gable B's Kant 1 corner across the module from gable A's, mm.
offset.title: Offset
